messages.author: bc4bc847c10f529f
messages.subject: basic affy qc steps
parts:
Hi,

I have been analyzing affy arrays with bioconductor in the following
ways:

library(affy)
library(affyPLM)
library(simpleaffy)

affyRaw <- ReadAffy()
hist(affyRaw)
boxplot(affyRaw)

affyRaw.mas5 <- call.exprs(affyRaw,"mas5")
qc <- qc(affyRaw,affyRaw.mas5)
plot(qc)

deg <- AffyRNAdeg(affyRaw)
plotAffyRNAdeg(deg)

pset <- fitPLM(affyRaw)
RLE(pset)
NUSE(pset)

image(pset, which=1, type = "resids", add.legend=TRUE)

Thanks to posts by Mark Robinson, I can do most of these steps with
aroma.affymetrix calls.

However, I can't seem to figure out equivalent aroma.affymetrix calls
for:

affyRaw.mas5 <- call.exprs(affyRaw,"mas5")
qc <- qc(affyRaw,affyRaw.mas5)
plot(qc)
deg <- AffyRNAdeg(affyRaw)
plotAffyRNAdeg(deg)
image(pset, which=1, type = "resids", add.legend=TRUE)

Would anyone know how to do the simpleaffy qc call, or the RNA
degradation call, or the PLM image residuals call?

Thanks very much for your help,
Dick

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] basic affy qc steps
parts:
Hi Dick,
 
Unfortunately, there are as yet no aroma.affymetrix implementations of RNA degradation plots or MAS5 P/A calls - they have been on the to do list for a while but there hasn't been great demand for them so far.  To do images of residuals, you can do something along the lines of
 
rs<-getResidualSet(plm)
calculateResiduals(plm, verbose=-1)
rf <- getFile(rs, 1)   # get the first array
plotImage(rf)
 
This assumes you have a ProbeLevelModel object called plm to work with.  See the page
 
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/exploratory-analysis-of-raw-data
 
Cheers,
 
Ken
